text: Xandria is one of the five Paragons of the kyrian Ascended in Bastion, embodying the virtue of courage. She is one of the more martial of Bastion's Paragons, and is unafraid to pursue enemies of the kyrian even beyond her own realm. Xandria oversaw the duties of the Temple of Courage in western Bastion before its sacking by the Maldraxxi House of Constructs. She is assisted in her duties by her Hands of Courage, Artemede and Apolon.
Xenxuju is a Zandalari troll found in Vol'dun. He was to use Soul Drain.
Xibalan Saurid are saurid located in Xibala in Zuldazar. Some of them can be seen fighting each other or feasting on dead Wild Direhorns.
Xav the Unfallen is the third boss located in the Theater of Pain.
Xalethar was a satyr located at Xalethar's Lair in Val'sharah.
Xav's Pike of Authority drops from Xav the Unfallen in the Theater of Pain.
Xeeli's Ritual Drafts drop from Architect Xeeli at Glutharn's Decay in Maldraxxus.
Xantuth the Blighted is an undead dragon located in the Theater of Pain in Maldraxxus.
Xuen's Bond is a conduit for Windwalker monks. It drops from Devos in the Spires of Ascension and Painsmith Raznal in the Sanctum of Domination
__NOTOC__ Xixin the Ravening is a devourer that spawns from a Swelling Tear in Bastion.
Xy'lonu is a broker located in the Keeper's Respite of Korthia.
Xy'le Dates are sold by the Fruit Vendor in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market for .

Xy'aro is a broker located at the Bazaar of Tangible Delights in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market.
Xy'darid is a broker located at the Bazaar of Tangible Delights in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market.

Xandria's Vigil, named after the Paragon of Courage, is a location acting as the entry to the Temple of Courage in Bastion. It houses the portal to Necrotic Wake. During the events of the Bastion questline, the temple comes under attack by the Maldraxxi House of Constructs.
Xy'noc is a broker located in the Grand Menagerie in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market.
Xy'nam is a broker located in the Grand Menagerie in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market.
Xavren's Gauntlets are a quest reward from Variety is the Spice of Death.
Xorothian Breastplate drops from Fel Commander Erixtol and Lord Commander Alexius in Stormheim.
Xorothian Waistplate drops from Fel Commander Erixtol and Lord Commander Alexius in Stormheim.
Xorothian Greaves drop from Fel Commander Erixtol and Lord Commander Alexius in Stormheim.
Xorothian Sabatons drop from Fel Commander Erixtol and Lord Commander Alexius in Stormheim.
Xorothian Vambraces drop from Fel Commander Erixtol and Lord Commander Alexius in Stormheim.
Xandria's Kopis of Courage is sold by the following vendors in Bastion for 1 Abominable Anima Spherule: *Alisius *Kelli Hoo *Provisioner Prothos *Battlemaster Endios
Xeri'tac's Unhatched Egg Sac drops from Xeri'tac in The Everbloom.
__NOTOC__ Xy'azam is a broker located at the Circle of Thought in Zereth Mortis. Together with Xy'kina, he is working on a Corrupted Architect. Aggroing the brokers will activate the architect.
__NOTOC__ Xy'kina is a broker located at the Circle of Thought in Zereth Mortis. Together with Xy'azam, he is working on a Corrupted Architect. Aggroing the brokers will activate the architect.
Xy'rath's Booby-Trapped Cache drops from Xy'rath the Covetous at the Ageless Shards in Zereth Mortis.
Xalzaix's Veiled Eye drops from Mythrax the Unraveler in Uldir. It is also looted from Cache of Uldir Treasures.

__NOTOC__ Xevveth is a dead Enlightened broker lying on the road through the Great Veldt in Zereth Mortis during Finding Firim. He believed it might have been a mistake of the Enlightened to exile Firim and went to find him, but were killed by Xy'teth before he could reach him.

__NOTOC__ Xy'anath is one of the broker assassins sent by Cartel Xy to kill Firim in Zereth Mortis, seen during Unseen Agents. They are located in the northernmost part of the Great Veldt, near the border with the Terrace of Formation.

__NOTOC__ Xy'bok is one of the broker assassins sent by Cartel Xy to kill Firim in Zereth Mortis, seen during Unseen Agents. They are roaming an oblong area in the northeastern part of the Great Veldt.
Xy'rath's Letter Opener drops from Xy'rath the Covetous in the Ageless Shards in Zereth Mortis.

__NOTOC__ Xarenak the Soulstealer is a Dominated automa roaming the southwestern edge of Provis Esper in Zereth Mortis, surrounded by dead uncorrupted automa and carrying a :Conduction Remnant in its hand.
__NOTOC__ Xy'kaz is a broker located in the Slumbering Vault in Zereth Mortis.
XS-001 Constructor Bot was obtained by combining 40 Certificate of Appreciation.
__NOTOC__ Xelleth the Souldrinker is a devourer located in Locrian Esper in Zereth Mortis.
__NOTOC__ Xaevian the Watchful is a kyrian located in the Eonian Archives in Bastion after channeling the Anima Conductor level 3 to the area.
Xavin is a blue dragonspawn located at the Cobalt Assembly in the Azure Span.
Xiur is one of the many runes that appears in the Chamber of the Guardian in Dalaran as part of Dabbling in the Demonic quest.
Xolleth is a red dragonspawn located at the Ruby Lifeshrine in the Waking Shores. She is found talking with Faramin.
Xius is a red dragonspawn located at the Ruby Lifeshrine in the Waking Shores.
__NOTOC__ Xemah is a bronze drakonid located at the Serene Dreams Spa in Thaldraszus. An indecicive Spa Guest is found nearby.
__NOTOC__ Xijan Thornpaw is a pandaren located at the Serene Dreams Spa in Thaldraszus.
Xaldrass is a black drakonid located in the Obsidian Citadel in the Waking Shores.
Xumanu's Hideout was a planned subzone in Vol'dun. This cave would likely have been the home of Xumanu the Twisted.
Xiddorm is a bronze whelp located near Naldormi in Thaldraszus.
__NOTOC__ The X-52 Rocket Helmet is a cloth type helmet which allows wearers to use the platform within Area 52 to launch themselves.

The color yellow is used in World of Warcraft in various different ways. One way is as part of the usual Blizzard quality color system for items (gray, white, green, blue, purple, orange, gold) or difficulty for mobs (gray, green, yellow, orange, red) and tradeskill recipes (gray, green, yellow, orange).
Yonn Deepcut is a tauren artisan skinning trainer located in Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore.

Yana Bloodspear has a large statue erected in her honor in the the Hall of Champions, located in the Scarlet Monastery in the Tirisfal Glades. She was born in Dalaran. Her current condition is unknown, but she was lost in the Tirisfal Glades.

The Yorgen Farmstead is an abandoned farm in southern Duskwood. The farm was once owned by Sven Yorgen who can be found at the small camp on the Darkened Bank. The farmstead is now in the hands of the Defias Brotherhood. Be wary when approaching the farmstead, as many stealthed Defias assassins patrol the area. Following the Cataclysm, the Defias seemingly abandoned the farmstead, which is now home to a new elemental mob known as Corpseweed.
Yldan is a night elf bag vendor located in the Tradesmen's Terrace in Darnassus. During the Burning of Teldrassil, he was caught in the chaos and could be saved.

Yeh'kinya is a jungle troll quest giver located at Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris. As a worshipper of the evil Hakkar the Soulflayer, he tricked the player character into helping him bring Hakkar back into the world of Azeroth. With the help of Prospector Ironboot, he was exposed as a worshipper of the evil god at the end of the quest Confront Yeh'kinya. When the adventurer confronted Yeh'kinya with this knowledge, Yeh'kinya escaped by turning into a green wind serpent, yelling as he flew out over the sea. It is then that the player was sent to Yojamba Isle by Ironboot, in order to speak to the Zandalari trolls and discover how to defeat Hakkar. This was a precursor to the Zul'Gurub quests.

Yonada was a tauren tailoring and leatherworking vendor located in Camp Taurajo in the Southern Barrens. She was killed when the Alliance attacked Camp Taurajo. Winnoa Pineforest sent a Horde adventurer to summon her spirit and put it to rest.
__NOTOC__ The Yellow Moth Egg teaches you how to summon a Yellow Moth companion.
Xyrol is a goblin master engineering trainer located in Area 52 in the Netherstorm.
Yama Snowhoof is a tauren quest ender located at the Splintertree Post in Ashenvale.

Yenniku is Vol'jin's youngest son. As is a custom with jungle trolls, he was given to the Gurubashi tribe of Zul'Gurub. However, he was lost to the Darkspear tribe after they left with Thrall. He was later captured by Zanzil the Outcast, who had taken control of his body and mind and apparently sent him to the Skullsplitter tribe to make them join Zanzil in an army that would conquer Stranglethorn. After being attacked by Ana'thek the Cruel, the adventurers of the Horde defeated the Skullsplitter Chief and bested Yenniku, retrieving Vol'jin son's soul using a Soul Gem, which they brought to , a Darkspear troll sent from Orgrimmar to search for Yenniku.
Xylem's Note was provided as an objective for Xylem's Payment to Jediga.
__NOTOC__ Yasmine Teli'Larien is a blood elf warlock located at the Sunspire on Sunstrider Isle in Eversong Woods. She has an imp minion.
__NOTOC__ Yil is a draenei mail armor vendor located at the Trader's Tier in the Exodar. During the Battle for the Exodar, he was inside Velen's protective shield.
Yeti Fur Cloak is a quest reward from Bartolo's Yeti Fur Cloak.
Yellow Sack of Gems drops from: *Nefarian in Blackwing Lair *Onyxia in Onyxia's Lair *Lord Kazzak in Blasted Lands *Highlord Kruul *Azuregos in Azshara *The Dragons of Nightmare
Yaluu is a draenei located at the Temple of Telhamat in the Hellfire Peninsula.
__NOTOC__ Yalda is a night elf spirit located in Auberdine in Darkshore. She is translucent but not stealthed. Before the Cataclysm, she had no functional purpose.
Yarzill's Mutton is provided as an objective by Yarzill the Merc for A Slow Death.
Yor's Revenge is an tanking ring which drops from Yor in the Mana-Tombs of Auchindoun on Heroic mode. It is a reference to the classic arcade game Yar's Revenge.

Yor is a summoned boss in front of Nexus-Prince Shaffar in the Mana-Tombs in Auchindoun, and is only summonable in Heroic mode. After completing the quest The Mark of the Nexus-King and obtaining either Shaffar's Stasis Chamber Key or The Eye of Haramad, one can open Shaffar's Stasis Chamber.
__NOTOC__ Yellow Dye can be purchased for from Trade Goods vendors, Tailoring Suppliers & Leatherworking Suppliers.
__NOTOC__ Yaelika Farclaw is an orc regents and poisons vendor found in Alterac Valley. She appears during the Heritage of Draenor questline at Frostwolf Village.
The Yellow Punch Card can be acquired from Gnomeregan, by using White Punch Card in combination with the Matrix Punchograph 3005-A.
Yagyin's Digest was provided as an objective for Forbidden Knowledge (Classic).
Yeh'kinya's Bramble is provided as an objective for Screecher Spirits. It summons a Screecher Spirit.

Yeh'kinya's Scroll was used instead of the Egg of Hakkar to summon the Avatar of Hakkar in the Sanctum of the Fallen God of the Sunken Temple if the quest The God Hakkar had already been completed. Unlike the Egg of Hakkar, it was not consumed after use.

Yazzai is one of the 8 different NPCs that can be with Priestess Delrissa, the third boss in Magisters' Terrace. He is an ethereal frost mage. He is crowd-controllable. He can be feared, but he is immune to seduce.
Yorus the Flesh Harvester is a vrykul gladiator in the Ring of Judgement in the Howling Fjord. He needs to be slain during Stunning Defeat at the Ring.
Yanis the Mystic is a vrykul located in Wyrmskull Village in Howling Fjord.
Yord "Calamity" Icebeard is a dwarf member of the 7th Legion and part of the unit who was sent by the Valiance Expedition into the Wintergarde Mausoleum with the purpose of exterminating the undead.
Yara is an ice troll found in Zol'Maz Stronghold in Zul'Drak. She is the daughter of Warlord Zol'Maz and Tiri, and a sister of Drek'Maz.

Ymiron's Seat is the throne room of King Ymiron, the last boss of Utgarde Pinnacle. To the right while facing the throne is the locked gate to the King's Hoard, leading back to the entrance. The gate will only open once Ymiron is dead.
__NOTOC__ Yggdras is a jormungar and the first boss of the Amphitheater of Anguish. Yggdras Worms spawn when he is killed.
Ymirjar Dusk Shaman are vargul found in in Utgarde Pinnacle.
Ymirjar Witch Doctors are elite vargul of the Ymirjar found in Utgarde Pinnacle.
Yamuna is a Zandalari troll trade supplies vendor found at Zim'Torga in Zul'Drak.
__NOTOC__ Yanni is a blood elf found on top of Warsong Hold in the Borean Tundra.
Yellow Lumberjack Shirt is created with Tailoring (400); taught by tailoring trainers.
Ymirjar Skycallers can be found in the Pit of Saron in Icecrown Citadel. Two skycallers are mounted astride their personal s pathing along the southern lip of the pit toward .
Ymirjar Deathbringers are Ymirjar frost vrykul necromancers situated in the Pit of Saron.
Ymirjar Flamebearers are vargul found in the Pit of Saron on the path leading to Scourgelord's Command. They are summoned by the Ymirjar Deathbringer.
Ymirjar Wrathbringers are vargul found in the Pit of Saron in Icecrown Citadel on the path leading to Scourgelord's Command. They are summoned by the Ymirjar Deathbringer.
Yili is a gnome found in Light's Hammer of Icecrown Citadel. She sells the Tier 10 armor for rogues.
Yeti Milk is sold by Lodge-Matron Embla in the Storm Peaks for . It also drops from Unbound Dryads in Crystalsong Forest.
Ymirjar Warlord can be found in Frostwing Halls of Icecrown Citadel.
Ymirjar Battle-Maiden can be found in Frostwing Halls of Icecrown Citadel.
Ymirjar Huntresses can be found in Frostwing Halls of Icecrown Citadel.
Ymirjar Frostbinders are frost vrykul found in the Frostwing Halls of Icecrown Citadel.

Ymirjar Harpooners are ymirjar found in the Eagle's Eye gauntlet of Utgarde Pinnacle, They drop the harpoons necessary to blast Grauf out of the sky and begin your groups battle with Skadi the Ruthless.
Ymirjar Warriors are ymirjar found in the Eagle's Eye gauntlet of Utgarde Pinnacle, they are stationed in the hallway blocking people from the Harpoon Launchers.
Ymirjar Necromancers are vrykul necromancers found in Utgarde Pinnacle.
Yetimus' Twisted Horn drops from Yetimus the Yeti Lord in Hillsbrad Foothills.
Yetimus Maximus is a quest reward from Yetimus the Yeti Lord (quest).

Yellow Martial Shirt is a shirt item that can be purchased for from the following vendors: * in Dalaran over Northrend * in Dalaran over the Broken Isles It can also be obtained from Free T-Shirts in Orgrimmar or Stormwind during Free T-Shirt Day.
Yorick's Bequest is a quest reward from Waiting to Exsanguinate.
Yasmin is an innkeeper stationed at Oasis of Vir'sar in Uldum.

Yargra Blackscar is an orc quest giver located at the Firelands Forgeworks in Mount Hyjal. She instructs adventurers to eliminate the Dark Iron dwarves laborers in Hyjal. She doesn't care if the dark irons are servants or slaves of the Twilight's Hammer cult, the simple fact that they are a foe to the Wolf Ancient is enough to warrant their death in her eyes.
The Yauj Brood are silithid scarabs that spawn after killing Princess Yauj in the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj.

Yor'sahj the Unsleeping is the third boss (or second if killed before Warlord Zon'ozz) to appear in the Dragon Soul raid. World first heroic kill on 25-man achieved 7.12.2011 by Blood Legion - US-Illidan.
Ymirheim Spear Guns are harpoon guns found in Ymirheim of the Icecrown.

:"What's a yaungol?" :"Know what a yak is?" :"Of course." :"Imagine one of those walking around on two feet, only angrier." :— Yoona and Zengi The yaungol are a race of yak-like humanoids who are the ancestors of the tauren and taunka. After years of living in the Townlong Steppes, they have been pushed out of their homeland by the mantid, and are aggressively trying to make a new home for themselves in the Kun-Lai Summit.

Yaks are large, shaggy bovines native to Pandaria and also found on the Wandering Isle, used as draft animals by the pandaren, grummles and yaungol. They made their first appearance in World of Warcraft during Mists of Pandaria.
Yan-Zhu the Uncasked is the last boss of Stormstout Brewery.
Yan Ironpaw is a pandaren master of the Way of the Steamer, a style of Pandaren cooking. He can be found at the Halfhill Market in Valley of the Four Winds.
Yan is a pandaren found at New Cifera in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Yi-Mo Longbrow is a pandaren found in the Zhu Province and filled with despair. He later aided in the defense of Stoneplow Fields in the Valley of the Four Winds with Wardens of Zhu.
Yan Quillpaw is a pandaren located at the Cradle of Chi-Ji in the Krasarang Wilds.

The Yan-Zhe River is the main east-west river that runs through the Valley of the Four Winds. The river comes to end in the valley at Krasari Falls into the lake below and splitting off through Krasarang Wilds as the Krasarang River. During Moving On, Yu'lon drops the adventurer off at the northern section of the river.
__NOTOC__ Yongqi Scouts are yaungol located at Fire Camp Yongqi in Kun-Lai Summit.
Yongqi Brutes are yaungol located at Fire Camp Yongqi in Kun-Lai Summit.
Yachi is a quilen located at Seeker's Point in Kun-Lai Summit.
Yao is a quilen located at Seeker's Point in Kun-Lai Summit.

Yalia Sagewhisper is the Master of the Shado-Pan's Omnia discipline. These spellcasters are charged with maintaining the wisdom, knowledge, and sacred traditions of the order. She is also the current gatekeeper and decides who can join the order.
Yak-Keeper Kyana is a pandaren found at Niuzao Temple of Townlong Steppes.

Yaungol Tactics is a wood-panel scroll leaning against a totem and propped up by a yak skull at the base, found at in the center of Fire Camp Ordo of Kun-Lai Summit. Interacting with the scroll is one of the requirements of the Pandaria exploration achievement The Song of the Yaungol.

The Yaungol Advance covers the southern half of Kun-Lai Summit—a great, desolate high plain extending from the Grummle Bazaar and the Temple of the White Tiger in the northeast, south to Inkgill Mere, the Kun-Lai Pass, and the Gate of the August Celestials to the Vale of Eternal Blossoms, and west to Firebough Nook and the Shado-Pan Fallback. The advance includes Fire Camps Bataar, Ordo, Ruqin, and Yongqi, Eastwind and Westwind Rest, Lao & Son's Yakwash, Muskpaw Ranch, Mogujia, and the Chow Farmstead. During the rise of N'Zoth, the area was invaded by mogu clans.

Yaungoil is a wood-panel scroll leaning against a yaungol oil well found at in the northernmost hut of Fire Camp Yongqi in eastern Kun-Lai Summit. Be warned that Terrorbane, an elite yaungol, paths in to the hut on occasion. Interacting with this scroll is one of the requirements of the Pandaria exploration achievement The Song of the Yaungol.

Yinying Village was a small pandaren settlement located in the southern shadow of the Temple of the White Tiger. After Xuen denied their leader Shonuf training at the temple, he ordered his Yongqi raiders from the nearby Fire Camp Yongqi, just to the south, to torch the village.
__NOTOC__ Yol is a pandaren drink vendor working at Chin's noodle shack in the town of Dawn's Blossom in the Jade Forest.
Yao the Collector is a pandaren located at Tian Monastery in the Jade Forest.
Yellowgill Frenzies are frenzies found in the water at the western end of the Ghostlands.
Yellowfin Sharks are sharks found at the Bay of Storms in Azshara.
Yelmak's Alchemy and Potions is a shop located in the lower section of the Drag in Orgrimmar. This is especially important to those training in Alchemy.
Yak's Milk Flask is provided by Yak-Keeper Kyana to feed Wounded Niuzao Sentinels for Fallen Sentinels.
Yellow-Bellied Bullfrogs are frogs located in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
__NOTOC__ Yellow-Bellied Marmots are marmots located in the Twilight Highlands.
The Yellow Serpent Egg is a quest reward from Choosing the One.
Yak mounts are vanity mounts that were added in Mists of Pandaria. One can accommodate passengers.
Yak Herder Cap is a quest reward from Unmasking the Yaungol.
Yaungol Oil Barrels can be found on the Serpent's Spine north of the Ox Gate in Kun-Lai Summit.
Yak Herder Wristwraps are quest reward from Resupplying One Keg.
The Yaungol Wind Chime has a chance to drop from the pandarian champion Dak the Breaker in the Dread Wastes.
Yorik Sharpeye is a rare tauren found in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. He is a Pandarian champion.
Yikkan Izu alongside Izu's Ravens are the final encounter at Rank 6 in the Brawler's Guild.
Yaungol Fire Carrier can be found at Fire Camp Osul in Townlong Steppes and is one of the treasures of Pandaria.
Yin is a pandaren child found at the Dawning Span on the Wandering Isle. She is listening to Lorewalker Amai's history lesson.
Yi is a pandaren food seller found in the Laughing Crane inn in Mandori Village on the Wandering Isle.
Yeasty Brew Alementals are alementals located in Stormstout Brewery.
Yang Ironclaw alongside Li Chu and Lo Chu are inside the Siege of Niuzao Temple.
Yak Attack is a quest achievement earned for killing 15 Sra'thik attackers at the Niuzao Temple for 5 seconds or fewer.
Yaungol Deathcult Shoulderguards are a possible drop from Ordos, the world boss yaungol on the Timeless Isle.
Yan-Zhu's Blazing Brew is sold in stacks of 5 for by: * on Timeless Isle * in Durotar (Brewfest) * in Dun Morogh (Brewfest)
Yaga the Scarred is an orc found at Daggermaw Ravine in Frostfire Ridge. She is accompanied by Severmaw and Bloody Tusk.
__NOTOC__ The Yak Statuette drops from Kunzen Collectors in Kunzen Village and can be looted from the doorway of their huts, in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Yaya is a pandaren child found in the Timeless Isle during the Celestial Tournament along with Jialing and Xiaohu sitting by a bowl of noodles.
Ying Greentill is a pandaren located at Stoneplow Fields in the Valley of the Four Winds.
__NOTOC__ Yammo is a hozen located at the Skyrange in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Yanlin Edgewater is a pandaren located in the Krasarang Wilds.
Yazheera the Incinerator is an orc found at the Archenon Siegeyard (on the rise, not down at sea level) in north-central Talador.

The Yongqi are a tribe of yaungol raiders that operate out of Fire Camp Yongqi in Kun-Lai Summit. Their leader, Shonuf, ordered the sacking of Yinying Village after Xuen denied him training at the Temple of the White Tiger.
Yong Woo is a former Blizzard employee and Senior Game Producer for Hearthstone. He left Blizzard in August 2018 to join Second Dinner.

Yenki is the son of a fisherman and as a youth would compete for Yalia Sagewhisper with his friend Chinwa. However, Yalia, possessing wisdom beyond her young years, realized that their competition would not end, even after her hand had been. Fearing that such a competition would not end until one of them was dead and the other left in guilt, Yalia made the decision to leave Zouchin and years later when Yalia would return to the village, Yenki, who would be married with cubs of his own, would not recognize her.

Yao Firmpaw was a pandaren physician whose career was so spectacular, his name is still associated with health and wellness in the Valley of the Four Winds. He never married; his heart was forever broken when his love, a young lorewalker named Lin succumbed to a terrible fever that swept through the Valley during the short reign of the hozen Emperor Rikktik. Apparently, Yao once gifted a carved bronze mirror depicting the Red Crane of Hope to Lin with the inscription "To my dearest Lin / My beauty, my dove / This picture of perfection / Your reflection / My love - Yao".
__NOTOC__ Yanas Seastrike is a night elf quest giver located at the Lunarfall Shipyard in . His shipbuilding work is renowned.
Yorn Longhoof is a tauren banker located in the Frostwall's Storehouse.
Yazigo is a jungle troll located in Frostwall if Enchanter's Study is built.

Yaalo is a tauren follower located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern. Prior to the Battle for the Broken Shore, like many other followers, he appears at the Dranosh'ar Blockade at the sparring ring, where champions duel in preparation for the assault on the Broken Shore.

Yiska is a tauren follower located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern. She later traveled to the Temple of Five Dawns as a member of the Order of the Broken Temple. She then moved to Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore.
Yepa is a tauren follower located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Yoiks is a goblin located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She will appear after building Engineering Works.

Yaeger-367 was a machine located on the southern coast of Tanaan Jungle. It required two players to pilot the machine in order to summon the Gaiju, which dropped the toy Gaiju Pearl. The vignette event was removed from the PTR before the release of Patch 6.2.0.
Yad Sivart is employed as a Game Producer by Blizzard Entertainment.
Yer Papers are provided as an objective for Your First Day as a Pirate.
Yorg Murkmouth can be found in an unnamed cave in Azuregale Bay in Suramar.
__NOTOC__ Yaris Darkclaw is a night elf located at the Dreamgrove in Val'sharah. He is in charge of recruiting druids of the claw for the arch druid.
Ymiron's Broken Blade drops from Ymiron, the Fallen King in the Maw of Souls.
Yakomo Hide is a healer on the Wavestrider. When last seen by Aramar Thorne and Makasa Flintwill, he was alive, but his fate after the ship's explosion is uncertain.
Ymirheim Defenders are frost vrykul located in Ymirheim in Icecrown.
Yellow Conservatory Scroll is a toy that drops from Instructor Tarahna in Eredath.
Yaga's Trophy Belt drops from Yaga the Scarred at Daggermaw Ravine in Frostfire Ridge.

Yigthregor is a felbat accompanying Lord Korithis at the Heart of Jade in the Temple of the Jade Serpent. As the Grandmaster and the Monkey King attacked Korithis, Yu'lon faced off against the felbat. When Korthis was killed, Yigthregor flew away.
Yaass'shaarj is about collecting a full set of Siege of Orgrimmar armor for one class.
Yialu's Talisman drops from Blood Witch Yialu at Zalamar in Nazmir.
Yoragdos is an employee for Blizzard Entertainment and serves in the role of Forum Engagement for the European World of Warcraft forums.
The Yellowed Treasure Map leads to one of the treasures of the Virtuous Blades. This is part of the achievement Treasures of Tiragarde Sound.
World of Warcraft: Year of Fear is a calendar released on August 31, 2008.
The Yellow Glowing Puffer is looted from the Bowl of Glowing Pufferfish. Tossing the item at a player grants them the Bioluminescent buff.
Yahlwei is a skeletal troll sitting next to Zul the Cuddly in the central Port of Zem'lan in Vol'dun.
Yarsel'ghun is a jungle troll located at Stormwatch Peak in Stormsong Valley. Zandalari Bloodletters assist her when attacked.
Yogursa is a bear located in the Arathi Highlands. It is also present during the Battle for Stromgarde.
Yorilan is a withered located in Suramar. He is part of the Riddle of the Hivemind. He is hostile to adventurers wearing a Yellow Crystal Monocle.
The Yojamba Exchange is a building in Dazar'alor. It is here that members of the Zandalar Tribe faction work, serving tasty treats and general supplies. It is named after Yojamba Isle.
